summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the Saudi Konkan Score Calculator Expo web preview at 390x844 viewport. All 14 requested features work as specified. Setup screen (default 4 players, threshold 700/1000, add up to 8, remove down to 4, start disabled with empty names), starting a game, scoreboard rendering with totals 0, score entry modal with all 6 quick chips populating the custom input, custom numeric input (accepts negatives via keyboard type 'numbers-and-punctuation'), save-entry showing draft pill 'جولة: X', submit-round updating totals & history in reverse chronological order, leader/loser highlight (trophy gold on lowest, warning red on highest after >=1 round), undo-last-round, reset-game confirm modal, theme toggle (dark<->light, sun/moon icon swap and palette change verified visually), AsyncStorage/localStorage persistence across reload, and Game Over detection with badge 'انتهت اللعبة! الفائز: X' and submit-round-button disabled once any total >= threshold. No red-screen errors, no failed API calls (no backend used). One React Native web console warning about deprecated 'props.pointerEvents' on the Game Over overlay – minor.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:426. Move pointerEvents into the style prop (e.g. style={[styles.gameOverBadge, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}) to silence the warning on web/newer RN versions.

action_items: Optional: fix the RN Web deprecation by moving pointerEvents='none' into style prop on the gameOverBadge View in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:426.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is ~935 lines; consider splitting SetupScreen, ScoreboardScreen, ScoreEntryModal, and getStyles into separate files under /app/frontend/src/components for maintainability (guideline: files >700 lines should be split).
helpers p() uses Math.random for IDs – fine for a local-only game but not cryptographically unique.
keyboardType='numbers-and-punctuation' is iOS-only; on Android it silently falls back. Currently works on web preview as tested. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage was cleared between test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows verified end-to-end via Playwright at mobile viewport 390x844. Storage clears via localStorage.clear() in the browser eval before reload. Reproduce game-over quickly by entering a custom score of 800 with threshold 700. The only outstanding item is a minor React Native Web pointerEvents deprecation warning – non-blocking.
